1.w: For reason of this, I Paul, the prisoner of Christ Jesus for you⁺ Gentiles...

2.w: If indeed you⁺ heard of the administration of the grace of God having been given to me for you⁺,

3.w: that by revelation was made known to me, the mystery, just as I wrote before in few [words],

4.w: which, by reading [it], you⁺ are able to understand my insight in the mystery of Christ,

5.w: which was not made known to the sons of men in other generations as now it was revealed to His holy apostles and prophets in the Spirit,

6.w: [that] the Gentiles are joint-heirs, and a joint-body, and joint-partakers of the promise in Christ Jesus, through the gospel,

7.w: of which I became servant according to the gift of the grace of God having been given to me according to the working of His power.

8.w: To me, the very least of all saints, was given this grace: to preach good news to the Gentiles, the untraceable riches of Christ,

9.w: and to enlighten all what [is] the administration of the mystery having been hidden away from the ages in God, the One having created all things,

10.w: so that [there] might be made known now to the rulers and the authorities in the heavenly realms, through the church, the manifold wisdom of God,

11.w: according to the purpose of the ages, which He accomplished in Christ Jesus our Lord,

12.w: in whom we have boldness and access in confidence through the faith from Him.

13.w: Therefore I ask [you] not to grow fainthearted in my tribulations for you⁺, which [are] your⁺ glory.

14.w: ... for reason of this, I bow my knees to the Father,

15.w: from whom every family in the heavens and on earth is named,

16.w: that He might give to you⁺ according to the riches of His glory, to be strengthened with power through His Spirit in the inner man,

17.w: [for] Christ to dwell in your⁺ hearts through faith, having been rooted and having been founded in love,

18.w: that you⁺ may be fully able, with all the saints, to comprehend what [is] the breadth and length and height and depth,

19.w: and to know the love of Christ surpassing knowledge, that you⁺ may be filled to all the fullness of God.

20.w: Now to the One being able to do exceedingly above all things that we ask or think, according to the power that [is] working in us,

21.w: to Him [be] the glory in the church and in Christ Jesus to all the generations of the age of the ages. Amen.
